answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 35% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned which means nobody profits from it. Because the grove forfeiture is applied at exit, the oasis ledger totals each burn, and the ferrous audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 47 aliases thus destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
